prompt:
Make a tightly localized anatomy/pose edit to IMAGE 1 (the existing C3 WIND SPLASH v3). IMAGE 1 is the MASTER for the exact drawing style, face, color, line weight, shading, composition and all environment. Images 2 and 3 are the same character's costume reference, especially BOOT CONSTRUCTION. The user rejected a previous attempt because it changed the art style and replaced the shoes. Fidelity is essential.

Keep image 1 nearly identical outside the pelvis and legs. Do NOT repaint the face, upper torso, hair, bow, hands, arrow, wind wake, or ruins. Retain the delicate thin anime lines, slender proportions, smooth clean cel shadows and restrained finish of image 1; no thicker linework, new painterly texture, more muscular body or bulky equipment.

POSE REPAIR:
Retain an AIRBORNE dynamic archer, not a standing or grounded lunge. Redraw the leg arrangement modestly to make a coherent mid-leap figure:
- Connect the waist naturally to one compact pelvis in the same three-quarter direction as her torso. Two distinct hips, not a broad sideways split.
- Bring the bent leg's knee slightly LOWER and INWARD from its current extreme left/up position. Its thigh should lead forward and downward from the hip with believable foreshortening. The calf folds back naturally from that knee, and the boot hangs beneath/behind it. Maintain a legible, graceful bent-leg silhouette.
- Relax the long trailing leg with a gentle bend at its true knee. Shorten its exaggerated straight stretch and lift its entire foot clear of the foreground bridge, with an obvious small AIR GAP. Both feet are airborne, consistent with a windborne leap.
- The two legs belong to the same person: matched anatomical segment lengths interpreted through perspective, coherent pelvis/thigh/knee axes, no lateral dislocation, no inverted knee, no compressed thigh emerging from the waist. Preserve her original long elegant legs; do not turn them into thick, short or muscular limbs.
- Keep opaque matte BLACK fitted trousers fully covering pelvis and both thighs. A few soft structured folds describe the hip flexion. Teal coat roots follow the corrected waist and pelvis, but its long flying panels retain the original visual sweep toward the right. Avoid covering all joint connections with new cloth.

EXACT BOOT DESIGN LOCK (images 2 and 3):
Preserve the original charcoal thigh-high, slim close-fitting boots, long tapering ankle shafts, elegant SHARP POINTED gold toe caps with the same small curled gold ornament, thin sole and slender medium-high dark HEELS. Keep the teal shield/leaf ornament at the upper boot ABOVE the gold knee armor; it is not a shin guard. The gold knee armor is the original narrow layered leaf/wing shape centered on the kneecap. Keep clean dark lower shins without new teal plates. No round toes, chunky soles, block heels, ankle boots, armored sabatons, new clasps, enlarged knee guards, changed motifs or replacement footwear. The pose can rotate the boots but must not redesign them.

Unchanged concept: arrow-tip-origin strong white/teal gale wrapping BEHIND her brown hair and upper body; white/gray broken arches, sparse pale-green leaves; exact C3 identity, original gold details and flowing teal costume. Do not rebuild the foreground into new steps or alter the environment for a standing stance. Retain existing stone silhouettes, only keeping the lifted foot distinct from them. No new objects, characters, text, diagrams or panels.
One full illustration, same framing and genuine alpha transparency. Keep all essential body and equipment within the canvas. This is a surgical redraw of pelvis/leg articulation with exact original style and footwear fidelity, NOT a new redesign.
